card.name: Punctuation before fiber in networking lists
card.fires_on: Commas, 'including', 'such as' and similar linking spots in networking text where the next word is likely 'fiber' (optical cable), usually after copper or cable types.

modes.description: A comma or linking word after copper, wire or cable, where fiber would come next.
